verificationFlow.step1: User connects wallet on https://belleepoch.xyz (Humans tab)
verificationFlow.step2: Frontend generates Self Protocol QR code with wallet address as userContextData
verificationFlow.step3: User scans QR with Self app — ZK proof generated from passport NFC chip
verificationFlow.step5: Backend verifies: age >= 18, OFAC sanctions clear, Sybil check via nullifier
verificationFlow.step6: Verified wallet stored in Redis — eligible for human provider registration

sybilProtection.mechanism: One passport = one registration. Nullifier derived from passport, stored in Redis. Re-verification allowed only if wallet data wasn't persisted from prior attempt.

humanProviderFeatures.providerLoop: Auto-starts when heartbeat detected, stops when offline
